trace.question: Identify the type of expenses and their total value approved for 'October Meeting' event.
trace.evidence: total value refers to SUM(cost); 'October Meeting' is an event name;

attempts.sql:
SELECT e.expense_description, SUM(e.cost) AS total_value
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
  AND e.approved = 'true'
GROUP BY e.expense_description

trace.final_sql:
SELECT e.expense_description, SUM(e.cost) AS total_value
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
  AND e.approved = 'true'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
trace.answer: The October Meeting expenses were Pizza ($51.81), Posters ($54.25), and Water, chips, cookies ($69.33).
